summary: The harness is the Continue CLI (`cn`, package `@continuedev/cli` in `extensions/cli`), a Node/TypeScript coding agent. Its entrypoint is `dist/cn.js` (esbuild bundle of `src/index.ts`, built by `npm run build` after the local `packages/*` and `core` dependencies are installed/built exactly as `.github/workflows/cli-pr-checks.yml` does). Non-interactive runs use headless mode `cn -p "<prompt>"`; `--auto` allows all tools (in headless mode Edit/Write default to "ask" and are otherwise excluded), and `--config <file.yaml>` supplies a local assistant YAML so no Continue Hub login or api.continue.dev access is needed. Model calls go through `@continuedev/openai-adapters` `constructLlmApi`: `provider: anthropic` uses `apiBase` (default https://api.anthropic.com/v1/) and POSTs to `<apiBase>messages` with `x-api-key`, converting OpenAI-style tool definitions to Anthropic tool_use; `provider: openai` would instead drive the OpenAI SDK with `baseURL: apiBase` (chat/completions). The run command writes a config YAML pointing `apiBase` at the proxy and runs one task; sessions and logs land under `$CONTINUE_GLOBAL_DIR` (set to /out/continue) in `sessions/` and `logs/cn.log`.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=debian:bookworm-slim
FROM ${BASE}

ARG NODE_VERSION=20.20.1
ENV NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false \
    NPM_CONFIG_FUND=false \
    NPM_CONFIG_AUDIT=false

# Only what the build needs; never touch the base image's python/node.
RUN set -eux; \
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git xz-utils build-essential; \
    command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Self-contained Node runtime under /opt/harness/node (version from .nvmrc).
RUN set -eux; \
    case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) a=arm64 ;; *) echo "unsupported arch"; exit 1 ;; esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/node /opt/harness/bin; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${a}.tar.xz" \
      | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1; \
    /opt/harness/node/bin/node --version

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH

# Harness source (build context = repo root).
COPY . /opt/harness/src

# Mirror .github/workflows/cli-pr-checks.yml: root deps, local packages, core, then the CLI bundle.
RUN set -eux; cd /opt/harness/src && npm ci --ignore-scripts
RUN set -eux; cd /opt/harness/src && CI=true node ./scripts/build-packages.js
RUN set -eux; cd /opt/harness/src/core && npm ci && npm run build
RUN set -eux; cd /opt/harness/src/extensions/cli && npm ci --include=optional && npm run build \
    && test -f dist/cn.js && test -f dist/index.js

# `cn` launcher on PATH; runs the harness's own CLI entrypoint.
RUN printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /opt/harness/node/bin/node /opt/harness/src/extensions/cli/dist/cn.js "$@"\n' > /opt/harness/bin/cn \
    && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/cn
run_command:
set -uo pipefail; mkdir -p /out/continue; cat > /out/continue/cn-config.yaml <<EOF
name: Sandbox Agent
version: 1.0.0
schema: v1
models:
  - name: proxy-model
    model: ${CONTINUE_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929}
    provider: anthropic
    apiKey: ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-proxy}
    apiBase: ${CONTINUE_PROXY_BASE}
    roles:
      - chat
    capabilities:
      - tool_use
EOF
cn -p --auto --verbose --config /out/continue/cn-config.yaml -- "$TASK" 2>&1 | tee /out/cn-output.log; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; cp -r /out/continue/sessions /out/sessions 2>/dev/null || true; exit $rc
notes: Key facts from the source: (1) `cn` has no env var for model selection; the model, provider, apiBase and apiKey come from the assistant YAML passed via `--config` (see extensions/cli/src/config.ts createLlmApi -> @continuedev/openai-adapters constructLlmApi), so the run command generates that YAML from CONTINUE_PROXY_BASE/CONTINUE_MODEL. (2) AnthropicApi (packages/openai-adapters/src/apis/Anthropic.ts) posts to new URL("messages", apiBase) with headers x-api-key, anthropic-version 2023-06-01 and anthropic-beta prompt-caching; hence apiBase=$PROXY_URL/v1/. To use the OpenAI side instead, set provider: openai with apiBase: $PROXY_URL/v1 (OpenAI SDK baseURL) and any model name, and api_style=openai. (3) Headless mode (`-p`) excludes "ask" tools (Edit/Write/MultiEdit) unless `--auto`, which applies AUTO_MODE_POLICIES (allow *). (4) `--config <file>` skips onboarding entirely (onboarding.ts runOnboardingFlow returns early); with no --config and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set the CLI would auto-write ~/.continue/config.yaml pointing at api.anthropic.com, so always pass --config. (5) Telemetry only activates when OTEL_* exporters are configured and CONTINUE_CLI_ENABLE_TELEMETRY!=0 / CONTINUE_METRICS_ENABLED!=0; both are disabled. version.ts fires one fire-and-forget fetch to api.continue.dev/cn/info at import time; it fails silently without network and does not block exit. (6) CONTINUE_GLOBAL_DIR=/out/continue makes sessions (sessions/*.json chat history incl. tool calls) and logs (logs/cn.log, debug level with --verbose) land under /out; stdout is also tee'd to /out/cn-output.log. (7) FORCE_NO_TTY=true stops readStdinSync from touching stdin; a prompt passed after `--` is the positional [prompt]. (8) Build follows CI: root npm ci (scripts skipped so husky doesn't run), scripts/build-packages.js (CI=true -> npm ci; builds config-types, terminal-security, fetch, config-yaml, llm-info, openai-adapters, continue-sdk), core npm ci + tsc build (core has native deps sqlite3/onnxruntime-node/vectordb that fetch prebuilt binaries at install; build-essential is installed as fallback), then extensions/cli npm ci --include=optional (its `prepare` already runs the esbuild build) + npm run build. The bundle (dist/index.js + dist/cn.js + dist/xhr-sync-worker.js) needs only node at runtime. Node 20.20.1 comes from .nvmrc; override with --build-arg NODE_VERSION if that tarball is unavailable. The build downloads npm packages and the node tarball, so it needs network at build time only.
